articles.title: Rat der Europäischen Union: EU stimmt für Mercosur-Freihandelsabkommen
articles.teaser: Nach mehr als 26 Jahren Verhandlungen hat sich die EU auf das Handelsabkommen mit den Mercosur-Staaten geeinigt. Friedrich Merz spricht von einem "Meilenstein".
articles.image_title: Rat der Europäischen Union: BRUSSELS, BELGIUM - JANUARY 07: Agriculture ministers from EU members states attend a meeting on the Mercosur agreement, at the European Commission on January 07, 2026 in Brussels, Belgium. Agriculture ministers from EU members states are convening in Brussels ahead of a decisive vote on the Mercosur deal expected to take place on Friday. The proposed trans-Atlantic free-trade agreement between the EU and the Mercosur bloc, which includes Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay, has been in negotiation for more than 25 years. Farmers across the EU have staged protests in opposition to the deal over fears of unfair competition from Latin American imports. (Photo by Omar Havana/Getty Images)
